accounting_scope: Recorded episode costs include failed and incomplete work. Missing fields and unattached physics are explicit; totals may be partial. Elapsed seconds are sums across episodes, not batch wall time.
interpretation: Outcome counts cover only validated completed episodes; all other planned jobs remain in statuses. A missing process record does not prove a process is live. This report makes no causal or safety guarantee.

setup_audit.scope: Saved study sources and instrumented evaluator match their hashes; all completed trials share code, policy and configuration except scenes, seed and output directory. This does not imply identical physical starts.

scope: All 24 planned engineering motion-repeat trials. Costs exclude the separate switch reference/replay and other batches; no optimizer training or reserved evaluation.
